$note: Dominican Republic. Only the keys whose wording actually differs from neutral Latin American Spanish — everything else falls through to base/. A reader in Santo Domingo expects 'regalía pascual' and would find 'bonificación de fin de año' oddly bureaucratic; a reader in Monterrey would find 'regalía pascual' meaningless. Both are served without a second catalogue.
